title: Topic 16: Free Time & Preferences - Vocabulary
description: Core words for free time & preferences: hobby, music, film, game, sport, play, dance, swim, sing, weekend. 8 tap exercises with embedded grammar.
canDoStatement: Talk about hobbies, likes and dislikes
introductionText:
hobby = a thing you love to do in free time
music = you listen to it (and dance!)
film = you watch it (one hour, two hours...)
game = you play it (phone, cards, football...)
sport = swim, run, football...
play = games, sport, music!  |  dance = move with music
swim = move in the water  |  sing = music with your voice
weekend = Saturday + Sunday
+ phrase bank: Do you like...? | Yes, I do / No, I
don't | my favorite...
+ grammar note: questions with DO/DOES, negatives with
DON'T/DOESN'T - and the -s moves to DOES:
She playS -> DOES she play? / She DOESN'T play.

grammarBlocks.title: SIMPLE PRESENT NEGATIVES & QUESTIONS (G8 - the big unlock):
grammarBlocks.explanation: SIMPLE PRESENT NEGATIVES & QUESTIONS (G8 - the big unlock): Do you...? / Does she...? / I don't... / He doesn't... + short answers (Yes, I do. / No, she doesn't.). The T15 survival chunks (How do you spell...? What does ... mean?) are now ANALYZED - students finally see the machine inside phrases they already use.
patterns: like + noun (I like music - like + -ing NOT
taught; A1 bar is like + thing)

explanations.A1-T16-VOC-Q1: Weekend = the END of the week: Saturday + Sunday.
explanations.A1-T16-VOC-Q3: Hobby = your free-time love. Job (T14) = work!
explanations.A1-T16-VOC-Q5: Ticket is for travel (T13) - unless it is a film ticket!
explanations.A1-T16-VOC-Q6: Do you...? -> Yes, I DO / No, I DON'T (not Yes, I am - that is for ARE you...? T5!).
explanations.A1-T16-VOC-Q7: I DON'T. He/she DOESN'T. (The -s moves into DOES!)
explanations.A1-T16-VOC-Q8: DO you...? DOES she...? And the main verb stays clean: Does she PLAY (never plays).
